reports.title: Omada Health Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: For the year ending December 31, 2026, Omada Health expects:
•Revenue in the range of $344 million to $346 million, up from prior guidance of $334 million to $340 million, with the midpoint representing approximately 33% growth compared with 2025.

•Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $32 million to $34 million, up from prior guidance of $21 million to $27 million, with the midpoint representing an improvement of approximately $27 million, or roughly five and a half times, compared with 2025.
